title: Unity in Diversity, or Many in the One
introduction: Unity in Diversity, or Many in the One is explored through people, places, time, institutions and economic or cultural relationships. Key source-grounded themes include Unity in Diversity, or Many in the One, observation, reasoning, application, evidence, reflection. Gurukul reorganises these into questions, comparisons, evidence tasks and real-life applications without reproducing textbook prose.
